'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Winston Plunkett DS Coruscant: Chancellor's Office (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Winston Plunkett]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Chancellor's Office (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|OVS16-41-Coruscant_Chancellor_s_Office-remaster.webp|label=Coruscant: Chancellor's Office (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' When in Coruscant...
* '''Username:''' Winston P
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
